categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of tooling and testing fixtures and equipment. Its products serve smart terminals (mobile phones, computers, wearables), smart automobiles (new energy vehicles and intelligent driving systems), AI servers (liquid cooling testing equipment and heat dissipation products), and heat sinks for communication, AI servers, and semiconductor industries. It also supplies precision components and structural parts for semiconductor equipment and industrial robots, and has recently expanded into drone components and brushless motors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including customized tooling design, ultra-precision machining, and modular small-batch production. It applies advanced manufacturing methods such as powder metallurgy and metal injection molding (MIM) to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Key technologies include helium mass spectrometry for leak detection, VOC detection for lithium battery leakage, semiconductor cooling with cold dry air, and liquid cooling systems for AI servers. The company also develops automated testing and assembly equipment integrating robotics and AI vision inspection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major electronics manufacturers and brands such as Huawei, Honor, Vivo, OPPO, Apple, Foxconn, Luxshare Precision, BYD, and ZTE. The company serves industries including consumer electronics (smartphones, PCs, wearables), new energy vehicles and intelligent driving systems, AI data centers, semiconductor equipment, industrial robotics, and drones. Its products are integrated into production lines and testing processes of these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant business concentrated in South China (Shenzhen and surrounding areas), East China, and other regions within China. It does not report significant overseas operations or revenues. Its headquarters and major subsidiaries are located in Shenzhen and Kunshan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, providing customized tooling, testing fixtures, and automated equipment used in manufacturing and assembly lines of downstream electronics, automotive, and AI server producers. It also supplies precision components and heat dissipation products that are integrated into end products by its customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding into new markets such as smart automobiles, AI servers, semiconductor equipment, and humanoid robots. The company emphasizes innovation in tooling and testing technologies, liquid cooling systems, and precision machining. It invests heavily in R&D to develop customized solutions that improve production efficiency and product quality, focusing on import substitution and cost reduction. The company also pursues external acquisitions to broaden its product portfolio and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized tooling, testing fixtures, automated equipment, precision components, and heat dissipation products. The company operates on a project and order basis, providing small-batch, customized manufacturing services tailored to client specifications. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other precision manufacturing and tooling providers serving the electronics and automotive industries, including large contract manufacturers like Luxshare Precision and Foxconn. It positions itself as a technology-driven, flexible supplier with strong R&D capabilities and customized solutions, focusing on high-precision, small-batch production and import substitution to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.13 billion, a 67% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 97.5 million, up nearly 75%. The company has shown strong growth driven by market recovery and expansion into new sectors. It maintains a gross margin around 30% and has increased R&D investment to over RMB 103 million. Total assets reached RMB 1.59 billion, with equity of RMB 872 million. Cash flow from operations improved significantly.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its deep integration of R&D with customer production line design, enabling highly customized, efficient, and cost-effective tooling and testing solutions. Its ultra-precision machining and modular small-batch production model provide flexibility to rapidly adapt to changing market demands. Proprietary technologies in leak detection, liquid cooling, and automated testing equipment differentiate its products. The company also focuses on import substitution and reducing customer costs while maintaining stable margins.
